design_golden_variant.note: same lse/delta as the op, plus P and dS rounded to the input dtype before the GEMMs (the kernel's documented semantics, DESIGN §8.1 golden). Diagnostic only -- the primary criterion uses the fp32-arithmetic reference.

legacy_convention.note: MLADenseBwdWorkload.ref_program recomputes delta = sum_j P_j(do.v_j) in fp32; the op's _delta_kernel uses delta = sum_d o*do with the bf16 forward output. Both are mathematically equivalent; the difference is a numerical convention that the bf16 elementwise band does not cover on rows with very few visible keys.
